text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a recruitment heatmap for DP beta so we can prioritize outreach this sprint. Goal: pick top 3 segments to fill 100 seats and have 6 early bug/feature signals by EOW. Context: limited onboarding ops for private instances.
aj: Can you share the segment list and rough expected conversion rates? I can overlay capacity.
sanjay: Was thinking verticals: fintech, docs-saas, ecomm, internal tools, and platform partners. Also split by readiness: 'can run private', 'can use hosted', 'needs SSO/HIPAA'.
maya: Yep — those dimensions. Also want 'strategic' flag for customers likely to convert to Dedicated.
elaine: Quick ask: include timezone coverage and legal review friction (high/med/low). That drove dropout in last pilot.
aj: I'll assemble a matrix. Propose scoring: (signal value 0-5) * (conversion 0-5) * (ops cost factor 0.1-1). We can normalize.
maya: Love that. Can you put it in a 1-slide heatmap? Use green/yellow/red bins.
research-bot: Survey results uploaded: https://redwood.app/surveys/dp-interest-2026 — top interest: docs-saas, ecommerce. Raw CSV attached.
sanjay: Nice. Early thought: docs-saas high signal, low ops, good for hosted. fintech high signal but high legal friction => deprior.
elaine: For launch criteria: 50 active daily users across 2 customers OR 1 customer with >1M tokens/month and no critical regressions.
maya: Add success metric: baseline prompt quality delta < 5% vs control and NPS >= 7 for partner cohort.
aj: Resource ask: ops can support 25 seats/week onboarding. We should stagger invites over 4 weeks.
maya: Can we do staged outreach: Week1: low-friction hosts (docs-saas + platform partners), Week2: medium friction, Week3: high friction if legal greenlight.
sanjay: Decision: prioritize docs-saas (20 seats), platform partners (15), internal tools (10) as phase 1.
elaine: Incentives: $500 credit + 1:1 product surgery + prioritized support for Dedicated migrations.
maya: Who's owner for outreach copy and qualification form?
aj: I'll own copy. @elaine can own qual form + legal scoping checklist.
elaine: 👍 will draft and post the form by tomorrow EOD. Link will include: company size, deployment mode, security reqs, primary use case.
maya: Ops: create a prompt set of 12 evals per partner. We'll run automated evals weekly.
research-bot: New task created: T-3452 'DP heatmap + invite cadence' assigned to @aj, due in 3 days.
aj: Will share slide draft in #product-design tomorrow AM.
maya: Final ask: add fallback policy — if a partner hits blocking legal, route to 'private pilot' track and keep hosted slots for others.
elaine: Noted. Also flag: timezone mismatch for EU partners — need engineer oncall window.
maya: Great sync. Next check-in Friday 10am. :calendar: 
aj: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
